**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 07:07  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant described a grand affair, a lavish banquet held at the finest hall in the city, with guests dressed in their finest attire.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jack and Phil, close friends and colleagues, brought their wives along for the evening.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jack experienced distress due to his allergies, triggered by spices and dust in the air, feeling a tickle in his nose.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Phil noticed Jack's discomfort and whispered, "You feeling alright, Jack? That nose of yours is starting to twitch."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jack attempted to downplay his condition, saying, "I'll be fine, Phil. It's just a little dust in the air."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Phil encouraged Jack to sneeze, saying, "Oh come on, Jack, don't hold back now. You know what they say, when you gotta sneeze, you gotta sneeze!"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Phil's wife unknowingly asked for extra pepper on her food, apologized to Jack, saying, "Oh, Jack, I'm so sorry. I didn't realize it would set off your allergies."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jack's physical state was described as contorted with the effort of holding back the sneeze, with watering eyes, a red nose, and puffed cheeks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jack insisted, "It's no big deal, really. I've got this under control."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Phil remarked, "Oh, Jack, you always do yourself a disservice. You've got the biggest sneezes of any man I know. Just let 'er rip!"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jack's resolve crumbled, and he let out an enormous sneeze that caused plates to clatter, glasses to shatter, and guests to shriek in surprise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] After the first sneeze, Jack felt another one coming and muttered, "Oh no," while Phil egged him on, saying, "Come on, Jack, don't be shy. Give us another one!"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jack let loose with another massive sneeze, causing chandeliers to sway and walls to creak, leading guests to rush for the exits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The banquet hall was left empty and in ruins, with Jack standing in the chaos, still feeling the urge to sneeze.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Phil clapped Jack on the back, laughing, "You always were a showstopper, Jack. I couldn't be more proud."
